text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everything's been going well since I've
become Matikanetannhauser's
trainer. As
she gazes at the clouds today though, she
has something
on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hm, I kinda want to mix it up with my
training today...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but don't get me wrong! That isn't to
say that your regimen isn't
plenty
stimulating enough!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's just that I saw some really interesting
training ideas on TV
yesterday. Some
runners actually do triathlons and even
play tag!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! And I've got just the idea for the
both of you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey there, Director!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I happened to be strolling over yonder
when I heard you speaking of
novel
training ideas. So listen to this!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: How would you like to get in some cardio, improve upon your ingenuity on the track, and build up some mental fortitude—all while playing a game?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I speak of cops and robbers, of course!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Loving the idea, Matikanetannhauser
enthusiastically ropes plenty of
other
participants into our special training
session.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Look at all this space! I didn't even know
that we had access to a field
like this!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It appears you can make a special request
to use these grounds if
your training calls
for it. We'll have no problem performing to
our
utmost here.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Let's get this party started! First, I'll
explain the rules.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Five of us will make up the cop team, and
five of us will be the
robbers. The cops will
try to catch the robbers within the time
limit!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If even one robber manages to stay out of
the cops' grasp when time's
up, then their
whole team wins! But if the cops catch all
the robbers,
then they win!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Robbers still on the loose can rescue
captured teammates, so the
cops gotta
stay sharp until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The winners will be treated to a super
schmancy parfait, so be sure to
give it your
all!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Rock, paper, scissors, shoot! Shoot!
...Shoot! ...Shoot!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right, let's get to robbin'!

text_block_list.name: Robber Team
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Our unit will apprehend these perps in
record time. Officers, move
out!

text_block_list.name: Cop Team
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A heated game of cops and robbers
begins. Certain crooks find
themselves in
the slammer without much recourse,
however.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Grrr! This sucks, this sucks, this SUCKS! I
almost got away too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Too bad. I guess the local precinct really
knows what they're doing.
So who hasn't
been caught yet... Whoa, only
Tannhauser? Seriously?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but she can really put up a fight when
her head's in the game. We
can still win
this! Keep it up, Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Maybe mayhaps I'm the only one
left? Yikes, what do I do?
Should I try to
go save them? I'll have to get behind them
somehow...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Nothin' to it but to do it! Ei!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I saw someone duck into the bushes
over there. After her!

text_block_list.name: Cop A
text_block_list.text:
Stop right there, Machitan! We've caught
you red-handed!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew, they're way too sharp!

text_block_list.name: Cop B
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Only a... little more... You should just turn yourself in!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Master thief Machitan doesn't get caught so easily!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We've got plenty of officers rested and
ready to tap in at multiple
points. Give it
up Tannhauser, you're finished.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... huff... Ha... I don't... think sooo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, whoooa! Machitan's got some serious
power! She just keeps
juking 'em!

text_block_list.name: Robber A
text_block_list.text:
It's been almost twenty minutes straight of
this. How is she not totally
exhausted by
now?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's just the kind of runner Tannhauser
is.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff... pant... wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We're getting nowhere, officers. We need
a new formation—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And there's my opening! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Machitan! YES! She's comin' to save us!
You seriously rock!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... huff... Geh... Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The master thief manages to give her
pursuers the slip and reach the
jail, but
then...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: OUCH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...She slams headfirst into a tree and
crumples onto the grass.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser, in custody!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mumuu... I was so close to getting away
with it too...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, that was one heck of a fight. Good on
you for pushing so hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The players on both teams are moved at
having witnessed
Tannhauser's display of
willpower and grit.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Muh... That's frustrating. I feel like I was so
close, but I can never
seem to win in the
end.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Even back in my days at the junior
club, I would sometimes get
sick before
races, not to mention the nosebleeds... It's
always
something.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Matikanetannhauser can be a little
slapdash.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Director! We just got back from the game!
Wait, "slapdash"?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Though I think we can say
that's a story of the past! Not
all can claim
to face such lofty ambitions with as steady
a mind as
you.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I see only the brightest of light emanating
from our future star! I'm
expecting great
things, and that is all I have to say! Ha ha
ha!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that really helps. The director
actually comes out to cheer me
up when
I'm feeling down quite often.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The director's words about Tannhauser
ring true to me. I've got to
make sure she
gets her chance to accomplish great
things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together with that amazing performance in
today's cops and robbers
game, I can't
help but feel a renewed sense of
excitement for her
future.
